title: Sample compression schemes for balls in structurally sparse graphs
summary: Sample compression schemes were defined by Littlestone and Warmuth (1986) as an abstraction of the structure underlying many learning algorithms. In a sample compression scheme, we are given a large sample of vertices of a fixed hypergraph with labels indicating the containment in some hyperedge. The task is to compress the sample in such a way that we can retrieve the labels of the original sample.
